description: This file defines a React component for a customizable modal dialog, including related components such as Warn and Trigger, and exports the default Modal component. It includes UI logic, state management, and interaction handlers for modal behavior.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: Main React component rendering a modal dialog based on props.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: A specialized modal component for displaying warnings with an icon.

methods.name: Modal.warn
methods.description: Static method to show a warning modal and return a Promise resolving upon user action.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Component that triggers the display of the Modal component on click.
